senses.gloss:
रुध् 1. रुध् (= rt. 1. रुह्), cl. 1. P. रो-
धति, &c., Ved. to sprout, shoot, grow,
germinate; [cf. न्यग्-रोध, 2. अव-रोध.]

रुध् 2. रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. रुणद्धि,
रुन्द्धे (ep. also रुन्धति, रुन्धते,
रोधति, Impf. अरुन्धत्), रुरोध, रुरुधे,
रोत्स्यति, -ते, अरुधत् or अरौत्सीत्, अरुद्ध (Ved.
forms अरौत्, रुध्मस्, अरौत्सि), रोद्धुम् (ep.
also रोधितुम्), to stop, check, arrest, restrain,
hinder, impede, prevent, obstruct, suppress, oppose;
to hold, withhold, retain, keep; to avert, keep off,
keep back; to shut, close, lock, shut up, lock up,
block up, close up, stop up, fill up; to besiege,
blockade, lay siege to, invest; to shut in, enclose,
surround, confine (with loc. of the place of confine-
ment or with double acc. according to Vopa-deva V.
6); to bind; to cover, cover up, cover over, obscure;
to oppress, torment, harass: Pass. रुध्यते, Aor.
अरोधि: Caus. रोधयति, -ते (ep. also रुन्ध-
यति), -यितुम्, Aor. अरूरुधत्, to cause to stop;
to restrain, impede, obstruct; to cause to be con-
fined; cause to be besieged; to fetter, enchain; to
oppress, torment, harass: Desid. रुरुत्सति, -ते:
Intens. रोरुध्यते, रोरोद्धि; [cf. perhaps Hib.
rundha, ‘secret, mysterious;’ rundhachd, ‘secrecy;’
[]
ruindiamhar, ‘a mystery;’ ruine, ‘secrecy:’ Goth.
runa, ‘a mystery:’ Old Germ. runen, runazjan,
which may be related to rt. 1. रु.]

3. रुध्, त्, त्, त्, stopping, restraining, impeding,
holding; [cf. कर-र्˚.]

रुध, अस्, आ, अम्, stopping, restraining, hinder-
ing, repelling.

रुधि-क्रा, m., Ved., N. of an Asura or demon
conquered by Indra.

रुधिर रुधिर, अस्, आ, अम् (according to
Uṇādi-s. I. 52. fr. rt. 2. रुध्; according to some
fr. a lost rt. रुध्; according to others connected
with rts. 1. रुध् and 1. रुह्; cf. रोहित), red,
blood-red, bloody (Ved.); (अस्), m. the blood-red
planet, i. e. Mars; a kind of precious stone [cf. रु-
धिराख्य]; (अम्), n. blood; saffron; N. of a
town; [cf. शोणित-पुर: cf. also Gr. ἐρεύθ-ω,
ἐρυθ-ρός, ἔρευθ-ος, ἐρυθρ-ιά-ω, ἐρυσίβη, ῥούσιος:]
Lat. ruber, rufu-s, rutilu-s (for old ruthilus),
rob-igo: Old Norse riod-r, ‘ruddy;’ rioda: Goth.
ga-riud-jo: Old Germ. rot, rost: Angl. Sax. read,
roder: Slav. rud-e-ti, ruzd-a: Lith. raud-a, rud-
[]
a-s, rūdi-s: Hib. ruadh, ruaid, ‘red, reddish;’
ruaidhim, ‘I redden.’]
—रुधिर-ताम्राक्ष, अस्,
ई, अम्, having blood-red eyes.
—रुधिर-पायिन्, ई,
m. ‘drinking blood,’ a Rākṣasa or demon.
—रु-
धिर-प्रदिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, besmeared with
blood.
—रुधिर-प्लावित, अस्, आ, अम्, swimming
with blood, soaked in blood.
—रुधिर-रूषित, अस्,
आ, अम्, covered with blood.
—रुधिर-लेप, अस्, m.
blood-stain, smear of blood.
—रुधिर-विन्दु, उस्, m.
a drop of blood.
—रुधिराक्ष (˚र-अक्˚) = रुधि-
राख्य below (according to some).
—रुधिराख्य
(˚र-आख्˚), अस्, अम्, m. n. ‘blood-named, red as blood,’
epithet of a particular precious stone.
—रुधिराध्या-
य (˚र-अध्˚), अस्, m., N. of a chapter of the Kālikā-
Purāṇa treating of the sacrifice of animals.
—रुधि-
रानन (˚र-आन्˚), अम्, n. epithet of one of the five
retrograding motions of Mars.
—रुधिरान्ध
(˚र-अन्˚), ‘whose waters are blood,’ N. of a hell.
—रुधिरामय (˚र-आम्˚), अस्, m. ‘blood-disease,’
hemorrhage (= रक्त-पित्त).
—रुधिराविल (˚र-
आव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, blood-stained, soiled with blood.
—रुधिराशन (˚र-अश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, feeding on
blood (said of Rākṣasas &c.).
—रुधिरोद्गारिन्
(˚र-उद्˚), ई, इणी, इ, spitting blood, vomiting blood;
(ई), m. epithet of the fifty-seventh year in the Jupiter
cycle of sixty years.
